skill.summary: Generate FFmpeg commands from natural language video editing requests - cut, trim, convert, compress, change aspect ratio, extract audio, and more.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of FFmpeg Video Editor skill.

- Translates natural language video editing requests into accurate FFmpeg commands.
- Supports cut/trim, format conversion, resizing, compression, aspect ratio changes, extracting audio, removing audio, speed adjustments, GIF creation, rotation, flipping, and screenshot extraction.
- Includes command patterns and user example phrases for each supported operation.
- Automatically generates output filenames if not specified.
- Standardizes all commands to include overwrite and hide banner flags for cleaner results.
